description: Cross-binding conformance for the two model constructs no evaluator in the executing bindings runs: a DISCRETE EVENT (`discrete_events`) and an IMPLICIT EQUATION (an equation whose LHS is an expression rather than a bare unknown, an indexed unknown, `D(unknown)` or `ic(unknown)`). Before issue #264 both validated and were then silently dropped: the event never fired and the residual was never solved, so a run reported the initial value as its answer. The decision this category pins is REFUSAL: an evaluator that cannot run the construct MUST fail the build with the diagnostic `unsupported_construct` (esm-spec §9.6.6), and the message MUST name the construct and the evaluator. It pins no numbers. The `control` case is the event document with its event removed; it takes the same array evaluator and MUST still run, which is what attributes the refusals to the construct. Julia's ModelingToolkit export runs discrete events and hands implicit equations to `mtkcompile`, so it is outside this category; Go and TypeScript do not simulate and only register the code.
